constraints.source: Each block shall deliver 4.8 to 5 MW at the DC output from an input of 13.8 kVac ±10%, three-phase three-wire plus PE
Efficiency shall be at least 98% between 50% and 100% utilization, counting power train loss only
Short-circuit withstand shall be 18 to 40 kA symmetrical at 13.8 kV, with duration stated by the bidder
Short-circuit withstand shall be 18 to 40 kA symmetrical at 13.8 kV, with duration stated by the bidder, and the basic impulse level shall be at least 110 kV
Output shall be 800 VDC nominal, unipolar, with ripple ±0.5%, static regulation ±1% and dynamic regulation

Outdoor enclosures shall be NEMA 3R, rated ·30 to 40 °C with derating stated above 40 °C, corrosion class C5, seismic design category D and 120 mph wind, with a design life of 15 years or more within a 10 to 20 ft by 8 ft by 8.5 ft envelope
